name: VoxBolt – AI Chatbot & Business AI Brain
author: voxbolt

sections.description:
Your website is the first customer-facing surface, not a separate chatbot silo. VoxBolt connects this site to a Bolt: an AI assistant trained on your trusted business knowledge. Connect your account, select a Bolt, train it on this website, and add it to public pages without editing theme code.

The same Bolt can support more customer touchpoints as your business grows:

  • Website AI chatbot: Answer customer questions from your business knowledge on WordPress.
  • Voice experiences: Reuse the same foundation for voice-enabled customer conversations in VoxBolt.
  • VoxQR: Turn brochures, packaging, signage, and other physical touchpoints into AI conversations.
  • Customer-question intelligence: Use the questions customers ask to find knowledge, SEO, and answer-engine optimisation (AEO) gaps.

This WordPress plugin adds the website chatbot only. Voice, VoxQR, and customer-question intelligence are configured in your VoxBolt account; they are not installed or enabled by this plugin.

An active VoxBolt account is required. The plugin opens VoxBolt’s hosted login/signup experience; it does not collect a VoxBolt password in WordPress. The plugin sends the connected site URL, WordPress/plugin version, and intentional configuration requests to VoxBolt so the service can train and operate the assistant. See VoxBolt’s privacy policy and terms before connecting.

Uninstalling

  • Deactivate pauses VoxBolt on the site but preserves the connection for a later reactivation.
  • Disconnect revokes this site’s VoxBolt access and removes its local connection data.
  • Delete removes the local connection data and requests remote revocation. It never deletes your VoxBolt account, Bolt, knowledge, conversations, or subscription.

External service

This plugin connects to VoxBolt’s service at https://voxbolt.ai. The service provides account authentication, assistant configuration, website knowledge processing, and widget delivery.

Privacy

VoxBolt processes data according to its published privacy policy: https://voxbolt.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open VoxBolt in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Connect your VoxBolt account in the hosted flow.
  4. Select or create a Bolt. VoxBolt returns you to WordPress to complete the secure connection.
  5. Open Build knowledge in VoxBolt. Your website is prefilled as the first source; extract, review, and train it.
  6. Return to the WordPress tab and enable the website chatbot when you are ready.
